description: Poll a JavaScript expression in the app until it returns a truthy value, then return that value. Useful for waiting on state changes, loading flags, API responses, or any async condition. Example: wait for globalThis.myStore?.isLoaded === true.

expression.description: JS expression to evaluate; polling stops when it returns truthy

pollInterval.description: How often to check in milliseconds (default 500)

name: wait_for_condition
